lemma transform_limit {A : ℝ} (h : TraceSpectrum F μ) (ha : 0 ≤ A) (ht : EuclideanAsymptotic F A) (u : inside) :
    Tendsto (fun r => lag (rescaled μ r) u univ) atTop (𝓝 (lag (coneMeasure A) u univ)) := by
    obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := u; obtain ⟨s,hs,g,rfl⟩ := future hu; dsimp only
    simp_rw [lag_invariant _ (coneMeasure_invariant A), cone_laplace _ _ ha hs]
    have hr : Tendsto (fun r:ℝ => r/s) atTop atTop := Tendsto.atTop_div_const hs tendsto_id

proof_context.conclusion: For a future timelike `u = g (s e_t)`, `lag_invariant` reduces `lag (rescaled μ r) u univ` to the time-axis transform at `s`, with `rescaled μ r` carrying the factor `Zlog r = r⁻¹^8 log(r)^2`.

lemma lag_invariant (μ : Measure E4) (hb : ∀ g : Lorentz, μ.map g.act = μ) (g : Lorentz) (u : E4) :
    lag μ (g.act u) univ=lag μ u univ := by
    unfold lag; rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ]
    simp only [restrict_univ]
    conv_lhs => rw [← hb g.dual]
    rw [lintegral_map (lagWeight_meas _) g.dual.act.continuous.measurable]
    simp only [lagWeight,Lorentz.dual_sent]

proof_context.conclusion: For a Lorentz-invariant measure, `lag μ (g.act u) univ = lag μ u univ`.
